notes.title: New patch
notes.notes:
In this new patch we solved the problem with the map background not showing on interiors and fixed the resolution dropdown getting stuck. And also a problem with the second boss in the cemetery area where sometimes he attacked you before the dialogue.

Sincerely,
Cat Logic Games team.
